documents.title: Constitution
documents.description: The principal governing document of the Club, setting out objects, membership, the Committee structure, meetings, and dissolution.

documents.title: By-Laws
documents.description: Committee regulations made under paragraph 28 of the Constitution, establishing the office of Vice-President.

documents.title: Code of Conduct
documents.description: Standards of behaviour expected of all members, adopted under paragraph 28 of the Constitution. Agreed by all members as a condition of membership.

documents.title: Complaints Procedure
documents.description: How the Club handles complaints about members or Committee decisions, including referral to the University Proctors.

documents.title: Safety Policy & Risk Assessment
documents.description: Risk assessment covering indoor events, socials, UK circuit trips, and overseas travel (e.g. Le Mans). Approved by the University Safety Officer.
